user.title: DI.FM Radio
user.description: Enter the listen key from Player Settings on di.fm, jazzradio.com, radiotunes.com, rockradio.com, classicalradio.com, or zenradio.com. A paid subscription is required. The key is stored in the integration entry and is never sent to the dashboard.

data_description.listen_key: Settings → Player Settings → Listen Key on any of the network sites.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate DI.FM Radio
reauth_confirm.description: The listen key was rejected. Enter a current listen key from Player Settings.

reconfigure.title: Update listen key
reconfigure.description: Replace the stored listen key. Favourites and the default speaker are unchanged.

services.title: Radio services
services.description: Choose which services to show when picking favourite stations. One subscription covers every listed service.

favourites.title: Favourite stations
favourites.description: Select stations to show on the dashboard. The list can be filtered in the previous step. Station names include their service. Search the dropdown to find a station.

player.title: Playback target
player.description: Choose the default Home Assistant speaker and the stream quality advertised for Premium subscribers. Streams play on that speaker through Home Assistant's media player.

data_description.default_media_player: Must be an existing media_player entity. The dashboard can override this later.
data_description.stream_quality: MP3 320 kbps is the recommended default because most speakers support it.

error.invalid_auth: The listen key was rejected by the radio service.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the radio service. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: The radio service returned an unexpected response.
error.no_services: Select at least one radio service.
error.no_favourites: Select at least one favourite station.
error.speaker_missing: That speaker is not available in Home Assistant.
error.speaker_incompatible: The selected entity is not a media player.
error.invalid_quality: Choose one of the listed stream qualities.

abort.no_stations: No stations were returned by the radio service.

player.title: Default speaker
player.description: Change the default speaker or stream quality.

favourites_filter.title: Filter services
favourites_filter.description: Choose which services to show in the next favourite list. Existing favourites stay selected even if their service is hidden here.

favourites.title: Favourite stations
favourites.description: Add or remove favourites. The previous order is kept for stations that remain selected.

artwork.title: Station artwork
artwork.description: Set a custom image URL for a favourite when the official artwork is missing or unsuitable. Leave the URL empty to clear an override.

error.no_services: Select at least one radio service.
error.no_favourites: Select at least one favourite station.
error.speaker_missing: That speaker is not available in Home Assistant.
error.speaker_incompatible: The selected entity is not a media player.
error.invalid_quality: Choose one of the listed stream qualities.
error.unknown_station: That station is not in the favourite list.

abort.no_stations: No stations were returned by the radio service.
abort.no_favourites: Add favourite stations before setting artwork.

play_station.name: Play station
play_station.description: Play a DI.FM or sister-service station on a Home Assistant speaker.

station_id.name: Station
station_id.description: Numeric station id from the catalogue.

media_player.name: Speaker
media_player.description: Override the default speaker for this play request.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stop playback only if DI.FM Radio started the current stream.

refresh_stations.name: Refresh stations
refresh_stations.description: Reload the station catalogue from the radio service.

set_favourite.name: Set favourite
set_favourite.description: Add or remove a station from the persisted favourite list.

station_id.name: Station
station_id.description: Numeric station id from the catalogue.

favourite.name: Favourite
favourite.description: Turn on to add the station, off to remove it.
